description: This file defines minification functions for CSS and JavaScript, and exposes them in a table called 'minifiers'. It utilizes external file handling via 'site/lib/file' and sets a metatable for the minifiers table.

methods.name: minify_css
methods.description: Minifies CSS code by trimming whitespace, removing comments, and standardizing formatting.

methods.name: minify_js
methods.description: Minifies JavaScript code by removing comments and unnecessary whitespace.
